eviter.sub: What the AI must never do. Just as important as the rest.

hooks.title: Hooks & calls to action
hooks.sub: What makes people stop scrolling, and what makes them act.

regles.title: Editorial rules
regles.sub: Your “bible”: the rules the AI will follow to the letter.

exemples.title: Your best content
exemples.sub: The most valuable input for calibration: paste your real posts. Optional but highly recommended.

reseaux.title: Networks & rhythm
reseaux.sub: Where you publish, and how often.

visuel.title: Visual identity
visuel.sub: Your colors and style for generated visuals.

objectifs.title: Goals
objectifs.sub: Finally: what you want all this to bring you.

dirigeant.label: Your full name
dirigeant.ph: The person who embodies the brand

secteur.label: Your industry, in one sentence
secteur.help: Be specific. The exact job, not the broad category.
secteur.ph: E.g.: Sports nutrition coach for active women

anciennete.label: How long the company has existed

pitch.label: In one simple sentence: what do you do, for whom?
pitch.help: As if you were explaining it to a stranger at a party.
pitch.ph: E.g.: I help [clients] achieve [result] thanks to [method].

produits.label: What do you actually sell? (products / services)
produits.ph: List your main offers, in a few lines.

valeur.label: Your value proposition in one sentence
valeur.ph: The concrete result your client gets thanks to you.

diff.label: What makes you different? (3 things)
diff.help: What others don't do, or don't do like you.

concurrents.label: Your 2-3 competitors or alternatives
concurrents.help: We'll never mention them — it's just to map your market.
concurrents.ph: E.g.: other tools, agencies, doing it yourself

histoire.label: Why did you start this business? Your story
histoire.help: The “why” behind the project. Often the gold of your communication.
histoire.ph: The trigger, the problem you lived, the struggle that pushed you to create this…

persona.label: Describe your ideal client
persona.help: Who are they? Job, age, situation, level…
persona.ph: E.g.: solo entrepreneur, 30-45, already earning but overwhelmed, wants structure without burning out.

desir.label: What they really want to achieve
desir.help: Beyond the product: their deeper goal.
desir.ph: E.g.: regain control, scale without burning out, build an asset that's worth something.

objections.label: Their objections / hesitations before buying
objections.help: What holds them back from saying yes.
objections.ph: E.g.: “I already have my tools”, “it's expensive”, “I don't have time to switch”…

vocabulaire.label: How do they speak? Their words, their expressions
vocabulaire.help: Your client's jargon. The AI will use it to sound natural.
vocabulaire.ph: Trade words, phrasings, expressions they actually use.

adjectifs.label: 3 to 5 adjectives that describe your tone
adjectifs.ph: E.g.: direct, warm, no-nonsense, expert, blunt

opt.beaucoup: A lot, it's part of the style

personne.label: If your brand were a person, who would it be?
personne.help: A character, a type of mentor, a vibe. Very useful to calibrate the tone.
personne.ph: E.g.: the entrepreneur big brother who tells you the truth straight.

inspirations_ton.label: Creators / brands whose writing style you love
inspirations_ton.help: We draw inspiration for the tone (never to copy).

themes.label: Your 3 to 5 big recurring themes
themes.help: One per line. These are your “pillars”.
themes.ph:
E.g.:
Mindset & confidence
Method / behind the scenes
Client case studies
My life as an entrepreneur

reference.label: On which topic do you want to be THE reference?
reference.help: The ground where you want to be people's first thought.

message.label: What do you want people to remember about you?
message.help: Your core message, your deep conviction.
message.ph: Your signature phrase, your strong belief.

opinions.label: Strong opinions you stand by
opinions.help: Divisive takes make the best content.
opinions.ph: What you disagree with in your industry.

mots_bannis.label: Words / expressions to ban
mots_bannis.help: Vocabulary that doesn't sound like you.

tons_eviter.label: Tones to absolutely avoid
tons_eviter.ph: E.g.: preachy, pushy salesman, cheesy, hype

tabous.label: Taboo / forbidden topics
tabous.ph: Politics, religion, sensitive topics in your industry…

promesses.label: Promises you will NEVER make
promesses.help: Important to stay credible and compliant.
promesses.ph: E.g.: no guaranteed numbers, no “10x in 30 days”…

legal.label: Legal / regulatory constraints
legal.ph: If there are compliance rules to follow.

hooks_ok.label: Your best hooks that worked
hooks_ok.help: One per line. The AI draws on them to open posts.
hooks_ok.ph:
E.g.:
For 2 years I undercharged…
90% of [clients] make this mistake
Nobody will tell you this, but…

cta.label: Your usual calls to action
cta.help: One per line. What you ask the reader to do.
cta.ph:
E.g.:
Comment the word [X]
Link in bio
DM me to talk about it

offres_push.label: Links / offers to push regularly
offres_push.ph: Lead magnet, free audit, sales page, ManyChat keyword…

bible.label: Your strict rules
bible.help: Everything that overrides the rest. Structure, what's forbidden, CTA dosage…
bible.ph:
E.g.:
1. One single CTA per post.
2. Always a pillar + a hook.
3. Never guaranteed numbers.

structure_post.label: Your favorite post structure
structure_post.help: How you build a post that works.

plateformes.label: Which networks do you want to publish on?

profils.label: Links to your existing profiles
profils.help: So we can pick up your style and history.

charte.label: Your logo
charte.help: Upload your logo (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP — 5 MB max).

style_visuel.label: The visual style you like
style_visuel.ph: E.g.: clean, premium, dark, lots of space, little text…

inspis_visuel.label: 2-3 accounts whose visuals you love
inspis_visuel.help: We take inspiration from composition and mood.

visuels_upload.label: Visuals you like (upload)
visuels_upload.help: Upload example visuals — {{max}} images max, {{mb}} MB each.

succes.label: How do you measure success?
succes.ph: E.g.: qualified leads, DMs received, audits booked…

libre.label: A final word / any useful context
libre.help: Anything we didn't ask that matters to you.

ui.lead: This questionnaire is the setup step for your account. The more precise and detailed your answers, the more the generated content sounds right — your tone, your audience, your words. Allow 20 to 30 minutes. Answer in your own words, no need to polish.
ui.note: Take the time to fill in everything, as precisely as possible. This is the material we use to run a real, complete audit of your brand and fine-tune your account — not a generic setup. The more detailed your answers, the more the AI will sound like you.
ui.finiSub: We receive everything, set up your account, and get back to you.
ui.emailPh: so we can get back to you
ui.robot: Please confirm you're not a robot.
ui.okBody: Thank you! Your answers have been sent. We'll get back to you to set up your account.
ui.fallbackBody: Automatic sending isn't available. No worries: download or copy this document and send it back to us.
ui.maxImagesTronque: {{n}} images max — only the first {{room}} were added.
ui.trop429: Too many uploads, try again in a few minutes.
ui.tabsPh: Paste 1 to 3 of your best {{reseau}} posts here. Separate them with a --- line
